description: buildCallbackRedirectUrl at core/index.ts:175 appends '/auth/complete' to FRONTEND_BASE_URL. REQ-AUTH-002 explicitly states 'Location: FRONTEND_BASE_URL (no path appended beyond what FRONTEND_BASE_URL defines)' and REQ-AUTH-006 says 'Location URL query string is empty or contains only non-sensitive routing parameters defined in FRONTEND_BASE_URL'. The implementation invents a path '/auth/complete' that is not defined in FRONTEND_BASE_URL nor in the spec. The PROP-AUTH-012 and PROP-AUTH-031 tests assert this path exists, compounding the deviation.
